The '''Mos Eisley Commerce Guild Hall''' was a building in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] world [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. [[Mayor/Legends|Mayor]] [[Mikdanyell Guh'rantt]] of Mos Eisley had his offices in this building.<ref name="SWG" />
